Source adapter for model=None, horizon=1 external scores only.
Original source files are unmodified; four algorithms/support files are hash-checked.
AST execution selects full original utility functions/classes, BasePredictor,
ScaleFreeOGD, _OGD, and SAOCP; skips original import statements and Enb classes.
UnavailableMerlion annotation bindings raise if a forecasting path is used.
No SF-OGD/SAOCP update, projection, expert, gradient or initialization code is changed.
Apache-2.0 LICENSE and copyright headers are retained. This pinned repo has no NOTICE file.
This is not a full online_conformal package installation.
